SELECT s.School,
       s.Street || COALESCE(' ' || s.StreetAbr, '') || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS FullAddress
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) - COALESCE(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) > 30;

SELECT s.School,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(s.StreetAbr, ''), s.Street) || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS FullAddress
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30;

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       TRIM(
         COALESCE(s.Street,'')
         || COALESCE(' '||s.StreetAbr,'')
         || CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.City,'') <> '' THEN ', '||s.City ELSE '' END
         || CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.State,'') <> '' THEN ', '||s.State ELSE '' END
         || CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.Zip,'') <> '' THEN ' '||s.Zip ELSE '' END
       ) AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30;
